info.title: MICROSERVICE-apiwizruntimedoc-List Banking Accounts Beneficiaries-v5-spec
info.description: The List Banking Accounts Beneficiaries API provides access to information about beneficiaries linked to customer banking accounts. This endpoint allows financial institutions and service providers to retrieve detailed beneficiary data, including names, contact information, and relationship to the account holder. Typical consumers of this API include banking applications, account management systems, and customer relationship management tools. By utilizing this API, developers can enhance user experience by enabling seamless management and viewing of account beneficiaries.

get.description: Fetches all beneficiaries associated with a specific account. This endpoint allows users to access detailed information about each beneficiary linked to their account, facilitating effective account management and financial planning.

requestBody.description: This request retrieves a list of beneficiaries associated with the accounts. The request body must be formatted in JSON and adhere to the specified schema.

200.description: Successfully retrieved the list of beneficiaries for the account.

ListBankingAccountsBeneficiariesRequest.description: A request body for retrieving account beneficiaries in JSON format.
